result.instructions: Tools for ShipBob, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which orders shipped yesterday, and what is the tracking number for each one?"; "Show me the inventory levels for SKU ABC-123 in each fulfillment center."; "List the warehouse receiving orders that are still in transit.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ShipBob data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run shipbob_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run shipbob_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run shipbob_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. shipbob_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: shipbob_list_channels
tools.title: List sales channels
tools.description: List the sales channels of the account behind this token. Call this first: the channel id it returns is the `channel_id` that the write tools need. API: GET /channel.

tools.name: shipbob_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders, newest first by default. Filter by your reference ids, a created-date window, or a last-updated window. API: GET /order.

limit.description: Records per page (the API caps this).

reference_ids.description: Your order reference ids (the reference_id you sent when creating the order).

start_date.description: Orders created on or after this date-time.

end_date.description: Orders created on or before this date-time.

last_update_start_date.description: Orders updated on or after this date-time.

last_update_end_date.description: Orders updated on or before this date-time.

has_tracking.description: Only orders with, or without, a tracking number.

is_tracking_uploaded.description: Only orders whose tracking was fully uploaded, or not.

sort_order.description: Order results by newest or oldest first.

channel_id.description: Sales channel id from shipbob_list_channels. Optional for reads; the API uses it to scope the request.

tools.name: shipbob_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: Get one order by its ShipBob order id, with its products and recipient. API: GET /order/{orderId}.

channel_id.description: Sales channel id from shipbob_list_channels. Optional for reads; the API uses it to scope the request.

tools.name: shipbob_list_order_shipments
tools.title: List order shipments
tools.description: List the shipments (parcels) that ShipBob created for one order. API: GET /order/{orderId}/shipment.

channel_id.description: Sales channel id from shipbob_list_channels. Optional for reads; the API uses it to scope the request.

tools.name: shipbob_get_shipment
tools.title: Get shipment
tools.description: Get one shipment by its ShipBob shipment id: status, carrier, tracking and line items. API: GET /shipment/{shipmentId}.

channel_id.description: Sales channel id from shipbob_list_channels. Optional for reads; the API uses it to scope the request.

tools.name: shipbob_get_shipment_timeline
tools.title: Get shipment timeline
tools.description: Get the status history of one shipment, step by step, with timestamps. API: GET /shipment/{shipmentId}/timeline.

channel_id.description: Sales channel id from shipbob_list_channels. Optional for reads; the API uses it to scope the request.

tools.name: shipbob_get_tracking
tools.title: Get tracking by tracking number
tools.description: Get carrier tracking events for one or more carrier tracking numbers. API: GET /tracking.

tools.name: shipbob_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products in the catalog. Search by name, SKU or free text. API: GET /product.

search.description: Free text: name, SKU, inventory id or product id.

tools.name: shipbob_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: Get one product with its variants, by ShipBob product id. API: GET /product/{productId}.

tools.name: shipbob_list_inventory
tools.title: List inventory items
tools.description: List inventory items (one per SKU) with their status. API: GET /inventory.

search_by.description: Free text: name or SKU of the inventory item.

is_active.description: Only active, or only inactive, items.

sort_by.description: Sort field, as the API documents it.

tools.name: shipbob_list_inventory_levels
tools.title: List inventory levels
tools.description: List on-hand, committed and available stock per inventory item across fulfillment centers. API: GET /inventory-level.

search_by.description: Free text: name or SKU of the inventory item.

is_active.description: Only active, or only inactive, items.

sort_by.description: Sort field, as the API documents it.

tools.name: shipbob_list_receiving_orders
tools.title: List warehouse receiving orders
tools.description: List inbound warehouse receiving orders (WROs): stock on its way to a fulfillment center. API: GET /receiving.

limit.description: Records per page (the API caps this).

statuses.description: WRO statuses to keep, as the API names them.

insert_start_date.description: WROs created on or after this date-time.

insert_end_date.description: WROs created on or before this date-time.

tools.name: shipbob_get_receiving_order
tools.title: Get warehouse receiving order
tools.description: Get one warehouse receiving order (WRO) by id, with its status and expected items. API: GET /receiving/{id}.

tools.name: shipbob_list_returns
tools.title: List returns
tools.description: List return orders, filtered by return id, reference id (RMA number), status or date. API: GET /return.

status.description: Comma-separated return statuses, e.g. AwaitingArrival, Arrived.

start_date.description: Returns created on or after this date-time.

end_date.description: Returns created on or before this date-time.

sort_order.description: Asc = oldest first; Desc = newest first (default).

channel_id.description: Sales channel id from shipbob_list_channels. Optional for reads; the API uses it to scope the request.

tools.name: shipbob_list_fulfillment_centers
tools.title: List fulfillment centers
tools.description: List the ShipBob fulfillment centers (warehouses) of the account. API: GET /fulfillment-center.

tools.name: shipbob_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List the account's inventory locations, with receiving and access flags. API: GET /location.

access_granted.description: Only locations this token can access.

tools.name: shipbob_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List ShipBob invoices for a date window (default: the last month). API: GET /invoices.

from_date.description: Invoice date on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

to_date.description: Invoice date on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

cursor.description: Pagination token from a previous page.

invoice_types.description: Invoice types to keep, as the API names them.

tools.name: shipbob_create_order
tools.title: Create order
tools.description: Create a fulfillment order that ShipBob will pick, pack and ship. This is a live write: it can incur shipping and fulfillment fees. Get channel_id from shipbob_list_channels. API: POST /order.

type.description: Order type. DTC is direct to consumer.

shipping_method.description: Shipping method name, as listed in ShipBob's Ship Option Mapping.

reference_id.description: Your seller SKU in the channel. Use this or id.

id.description: ShipBob product id. Use this or reference_id.

name.description: Product name. Required when no ShipBob product matches reference_id.

products.description: Order lines. Each line needs reference_id or id.

order_number.description: Your display order number, if different from reference_id.

purchase_date.description: When the customer placed the order.

tags.description: Free tags for your own use.

tools.name: shipbob_cancel_order
tools.title: Cancel order
tools.description: Cancel an order that has not shipped. A cancel is final for that order; ShipBob may refuse it after picking starts. API: POST /order/{orderId}:cancel.

tools.name: shipbob_update_shipment_address
tools.title: Update shipment address
tools.description: Replace the delivery address of a shipment that has not shipped yet. Sends the full new address. API: PUT /shipment/{shipmentId}:updateAddress.

override_verification.description: Skip the address check and keep this address as given.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with ShipBob
prompts.description: What you can do with ShipBob here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: follow_an_order_from_shipment_to_delivery
prompts.title: Follow an order from shipment to delivery
prompts.description: List the shipments of one order. Read the status history of a shipment, and look up carrier tracking events by tracking number.

prompts.name: check_stock_across_fulfillment_centers
prompts.title: Check stock across fulfillment centers
prompts.description: Read inventory items by SKU, with on-hand, committed and available stock. List the fulfillment centers of the account.

prompts.name: follow_inbound_stock_still_in_transit
prompts.title: Follow inbound stock still in transit
prompts.description: List the warehouse receiving orders for stock on its way to a fulfillment center. Open one to read its status and expected items.

prompts.name: create_a_fulfillment_order_for_a_channel
prompts.title: Create a fulfillment order for a channel
prompts.description: Read the channel id of your store first. Then create an order for ShipBob to pick, pack and ship. The order can incur shipping and fulfillment fees.

prompts.name: cancel_an_order_that_has_not_shipped
prompts.title: Cancel an order that has not shipped
prompts.description: Read the order first. Cancel it only if it has not shipped, because ShipBob may refuse a cancel after picking starts.
